name: Raffles Medical Group Ltd
summary: Raffles Medical Group Ltd provides private healthcare services in Singapore, Greater China, Vietnam, Cambodia, and Japan. It operates through four segments: Healthcare Services, Hospital Services, Investment Holdings, and Insurance Services. The company operates Raffles Hospital that offers 24-hour acute and critical care; ambulance services and mobile medical calls to home, hotels, worksites, and onboard ships; and triage, emergency consultation, and inpatient ward admission services.
